CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `nlm_entries` (
  `id` BIGINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  `term` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `source_url` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `mesh_url` TEXT NULL,
  `mesh_name` TEXT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `nlm_classes` (
  `entry_id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `number` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `url` TEXT NULL,
  KEY idx_entry (entry_id),
  KEY idx_number (number)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `nlm_references` (
  `entry_id` BIGINT NOT NULL,
  `relation` VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
  `target` TEXT NOT NULL,
  KEY idx_entry (entry_id),
  KEY idx_relation (relation)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `nlm_mapping` (
  `mesh_id` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
  `descriptor` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `number` VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  `term` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `source_url` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `match_method` VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  KEY idx_mesh_id (mesh_id),
  KEY idx_number (number),
  KEY idx_descriptor (descriptor(150))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
